gfx942.source: tier-A XCD-remap autotune (gfx942 MI300X, 2026-06-10) + skew compact static grid (2026-07-06) + F3 L2-residency compact tile ordering (2026-07-06): tune_jdbba_xcd.py cold-L2 do_bench; ALL skew now uses the compact TILE_MAP (device prep cached per seq_offsets object, amortized across forward). B120_D256 skew uses naive group-major order; large-B (B1024) OR large-weight (D>=512) skew uses the F3 XCD-aware order (xcd_c=32, xcd_w=8) which clusters a group's M-tiles on one XCD's L2 (B1024_D512 skew L2 hit 36->75%, -20% time; B1024_D256 -15%, B120_D512 -12%). Skew routing is code-gated in jagged_dense_bmm_dispatch_v2.py (_skew_compact_xcd), NOT in this JSON. Bench: op_tests/flydsl_tests/bench_jagged_dense_bmm_perf.py --regime both --metric time -test.

B120D256K256N7680.source: threads=512 (gfx942, 2026-06-11): 8-warp (1,8,1) layout halves the fp32 C-accumulator AGPR/thread (64->32 fp32 -> 128->64 AGPR), raising occupancy on the AGPR-bound D256 short-K-loop. do_bench cold-L2 uniform 0.487 vs 0.563 (-13.5%) atop the xcd_c=32/w=16 winner, cos=1.0. Loses on D512 (already MFMA-bound) and all skew -> D256-uniform only.

B1024D256K256N7680.source: threads=512 + XCD re-tune (gfx942, 2026-06-11): 8-warp (1,8,1) layout halves the fp32 C-accumulator AGPR/thread, raising occupancy on the AGPR-bound D256 short-K-loop. XCD re-swept at threads=512 (tune_jdbba_xcd_t512.py): c=32/w=8 now wins (4.121) vs the threads=256-era c=32/w=16 (4.181); occupancy doubling shifted the L2 sweet spot. do_bench cold-L2 uniform 4.121 vs 4.449 baseline (-7.4%), cos=1.0. D256-uniform only (D512 and skew regress).

gfx950.source: offline autotune (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-06-09): rocprofv3 --kernel-trace device p10, Mi=7680; swept xcd_c in [1, 16, 32, 60, 120, 240], xcd_w in [4, 8], use_mfma_k32=True; correctness cos>0.999 vs torch eager. 4 headline shapes.

B1024D256K256N7680.source: dense XCD re-sweep (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-07-07, tune_jdbba_xcd.py grid c={40..160} w={4..24}): xcd_c=48/xcd_w=24 -> 2.134ms vs 2.169 at c=60/w=16 (+1.6% e2e A/B, 2/2 runs 2.129/2.139), cos=1.0. Flips B1024_D256 uniform from parity to ~1.026x AHEAD of Triton (2.134 vs 2.19). Prior: c=60/w=16 (2026-07-06). tune_jdbba_xcd.py --xcd-c 40 48 56 60 64 72 80 90 --xcd-w 8 12 16 24.

B1024D512K512N7680.source: tile-fold (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-06-10): do_bench cold-L2 uniform, 256x256 tile + xcd_c=120 -> 5.82ms vs 5.98ms at 128x128 (-2.7%), cos=1.0. 256x256 needs 128KB epilogue LDS (fits CDNA4 160KB, not CDNA3 64KB). SKEW: skew_xcd_c=8 (NOT remap-off) -> 1.23ms vs 1.26 (-1.7%, 5/5 trials); for this large-D512 skew shape the L2-reuse of a modest chunk beats the load-imbalance penalty. RE-SWEEP 2026-07-06 (FlyDSL 0.2.2, finer c in {48,56,60,64,72,90,120}x{8,16}, dual-run on gpu0): c=60 and c=120 TIE (~5.46-5.50ms both); c=48/c=64 are cliffs (~6.0ms). Kept documented c=120 (c=60 within-noise, not a robust >1% win).

B120D256K256N7680.source: dense XCD re-sweep (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-07-07, tune_jdbba_xcd.py grid c={40..160} w={4..24}): xcd_c=48/xcd_w=24 -> 0.2707ms vs 0.2806 at c=60/w=8 (+3.5% e2e A/B, 2/2 runs 0.2707/0.2708), cos=1.0. Flips B120_D256 uniform from parity to ~1.02x AHEAD of Triton (0.2707 vs 0.276).

B120D256K256N16384.source: XCD re-sweep (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-07-07, do_bench cold-L2 uniform, tune_jdbba_xcd.py): xcd_c=90/xcd_w=16 -> 0.5640ms vs 0.5754 at c=32/w=8 (+2.0% e2e), cos=1.0. Ports the 2026-07-06 headline 'w=16 on D256' win to Mi=16384; D256 optimum shifts c=60->90 at Mi=16384. Tile stays 128x128.

B1024D256K256N16384.source: XCD re-sweep (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-07-07, do_bench cold-L2 uniform, tune_jdbba_xcd.py): xcd_c=90/xcd_w=16 -> 4.4862ms vs 4.6529 at c=32/w=8 (+3.7% e2e), cos=1.0. Ports the 2026-07-06 headline 'w=16 on D256' win to Mi=16384; D256 optimum shifts c=60->90 at Mi=16384. Tile stays 128x128.

B1024D512K512N16384.source: Mi=16384 deployment sweep (gfx950, 2026-06-10): 256x256 -> 12.44ms vs 12.85 at 128x128 (-3.2%). 256x256 needs 128KB LDS (CDNA4 only). _mi16k_winners.py. cos=1.0.

B64D512K1024N8192.source: Songlin MoE deploy fold (gfx950 MI355X, 2026-07-07, _tile_fold_probe.py direct-call within-run A/B, do_bench cold-L2 uniform, 3 runs): tile 128x128->256x256 -> 0.739ms vs 0.806 (-8.25%, 742-750 TFLOPS vs 682), cos=1.0. ~97% of hipBLASLt dense ceiling (766 TFLOPS). 256x256 needs 128KB epilogue LDS (reuses A-stage region; fits CDNA4 160KB). xcd_c=60/w=8 already optimal for the folded tile (swept c={32,48,60,90,120,240}xw={8,16}: c=60/w=8 best; c>=120 collapses ~2.2ms). Partial folds regress (256x128 +13%, 128x256 +24%, 128x512 +8%). Skew unaffected (compact path uses kernel BLOCK_M=128).
